qualityChecks: All 6 review questions, 9 applications and 8 QuickQuiz checked against source; all 33 lettered application subparts covered.
Printed quiz key b,c,d,b,a,d,b,d checked; Kayla and roommate both have 1.5 laundry loads per dinner opportunity cost.
Source rancher name is Ruby. Exact Frank/Ruby production, trade and consumption retained; figures now use correct 32/8 and 48/24 intercepts.
Frank consumption (17 potatoes,5 meat); Ruby consumption (27 potatoes,13 meat); each lies outside the respective individual PPF.
Naomi Osaka example preserves 2 hours/$30000, Hari 4 hours/$50 and strictly beneficial hiring range 50<wage<30000.
Required productivity and opportunity-cost tables added to application 2; country PPFs slope downward on common quantitative axes.
Application 2 trade preserved: 200 million cars for 400 million tons grain; final US 200 cars/600 grain, Japan 200 cars/400 grain.
Canada PPF, initial 10 cars/150 wheat and trade 10 cars/200 wheat correctly plotted with million-unit axes.
Scotland exports sweaters and imports scones; lower sweater productivity retains distinct opportunity costs 40 versus 50.
German/French wine time X is positive; equal opportunity costs at X=3, Germany exports cars for 0<X<3.
Application 8 consumption trade points added: US 50 shirts/13 computers, China 50 shirts/7 computers; no comparative-advantage difference after China reaches 100 shirts or 20 computers.
PPF curvature now attributes outward bowing to increasing opportunity cost; equal opportunity costs give no strict comparative advantage.
HTML stack balanced, local fragment has 11 direct sibling sections; all 7 SVGs parse and ARIA references resolve to unique c3- IDs.
